name: Olivia at L&T Realty Raintree Boulevard

value.data: Olivia at L&T Realty Raintree Boulevard

Located in Hebbal, this project offers superior features, luxurious amenities, and abundant greenery. It boasts proximity to L&T Tech Park and Manyata Tech Park, making it ideal for IT professionals.. Configurations: 3 BHK, 4 BHK

Residents generally appreciate the luxurious and spacious apartments, the wide range of modern amenities, and the well-maintained environment. The project's strategic location with good connectivity is also a significant positive, though some residents express concerns about traffic congestion in the surrounding area and the pace of local infrastructure development.
